summary.text: Margo Logan is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 44, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Democrat Travis Nelson; Ballotpedia lists her profession as analyst and expert witness.

paragraphs.text: Logan earned a bachelor's degree from Central Washington State University in 1976 and a master's degree from Portland State University in 1992.

Ballotpedia says her career includes work as an analyst and expert witness on civil lawsuits, administrative hearings and family court matters involving daycare licensing, child protective services, public schools and government regulation of small businesses.
She advanced from the 2020 Republican primary for District 44 and lost the general election to incumbent Tina Kotek.

In a 2021 Ballotpedia survey, Logan described herself as a former group life counselor to foster teens, child protective services investigator and daycare licensor who is now an expert witness in civil lawsuits.
She said she supports school choice with both public and private options, and that transparency is the policy area she cares about most.
